text: A few things made this not very enticing to use in the free version. Impossible to make new affirmations though choosing to do so. It only edited the one I allready had made. Choosing "write your own" ended in Hal's template anyways. Also not much you can do unless you pay for it. Hopefully much much better in paid version.
author: Mette Jensen
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback! I’m sorry to hear about the challenges you faced with the free version. Your insights about affirmations and the limited functionality are valuable, and we’ll share this with our team for improvement. The paid version does unlock many more features designed to enhance your experience.
